items.heading: Fish and Chips
details: Key ingredients: white fish fillets, flour, beer, potatoes, oil
Cut potatoes into thick chips and fry until golden, then drain.
Dip fish fillets in a light beer batter.
Deep-fry the battered fish until crisp and golden.
Serve hot with the chips, salt and malt vinegar.

items.heading: Shepherd's Pie
details: Key ingredients: minced lamb, onion, carrot, peas, mashed potato, gravy
Brown minced lamb with onion and carrot, then add gravy and peas.
Simmer until thickened and pour into a baking dish.
Top evenly with mashed potato, ridging the surface with a fork.
Bake until the potato top is golden and the filling bubbles.

items.heading: Scones with Clotted Cream
details: Key ingredients: flour, butter, sugar, milk, baking powder, jam, clotted cream
Rub cold butter into flour, sugar and baking powder until crumbly.
Mix in milk just until a soft dough forms, then pat out and cut rounds.
Bake until risen and golden on top.
Split warm and serve with jam and clotted cream.
